prompt.text:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE new original full-bleed landscape racing-adventure SCENE illustration for a friendly casual mobile board game. Landscape3:2 composition. Illustration only, no interface.
Primary request: A bright joyful cartoon motor-racing adventure on a curving black asphalt racetrack, surrounded by vivid lush green grass, with soft blue/lavender mountains and a clear light-blue sky in the distance. Exactly TWO charming open-top race cars with friendly human drivers.
Foreground: at the lower left/center, a chunky dark navy/charcoal vintage-style open racing car moving energetically around a bend toward the viewer. Large rounded grey vertical front grille, black rubber tires, simple metallic highlights, warm red seat/interior. The driver is a cheerful friendly ELDERLY GENTLEMAN with white side hair, a neat fluffy white moustache, warm smiling eyes, and a happy expression, wearing a simple dark blue jacket over a light shirt. He sits safely inside the car with hands holding the steering wheel; his face remains clearly readable. New generic cartoon gentleman, no branded mascot details.
Middle distance: toward the upper right, a smaller bright PURPLE open-top race car follows the curved track. A friendly smiling young adult driver with short dark hair and warm medium skin is visible above the cockpit, wearing a simple bright shirt. The purple car is completely separate from the foreground car, clearly further back. No third car.
Track and environment: the black racetrack curves across the foreground, bends through the middle ground, and recedes toward the right. Simple short white dashed lane markings follow the curve. Thick rich green grass edges frame the track. A few compact playful WHITE CARTOON EXHAUST PUFFS trail behind the cars to show motion. Very simple distant pine-tree silhouettes and rounded pale blue/purple mountain ridges beneath the bright blue sky. Keep the composition clean, joyful and readable in a compact popup illustration.
Style/medium: polished colorful soft3D cartoon game illustration, smooth rounded shapes, gently bevelled cars, friendly expressive characters, cheerful sunlight, soft internal/contact shading inside the scene only. Energetic yet welcoming and safe, not gritty motorsport. Entire rectangle is filled by scenery, with no blank or transparent margins.
Text: NONE.
Hard constraints: this is a NEW illustration from the described concept, not a screenshot copy or screenshot collage. No UI whatsoever, no title, no caption, no letters, no digits, no car numbers, no logos or brand emblems on cars/clothes, no event wordmark, no checkered flags, no badge, no percentage bubble, no timer, no price, no count, no purchase button, no panel, no border, no frame, no reward dice, no banknotes/cash, no foil card packs, no product objects, no floating confetti, no external UI cast/drop shadow. Do not add a third car or extra background characters. Opaque rectangular scene artwork only.
